cssText: .mburger { background: transparent; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 0px; color: inherit; display: inline-block; position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; height: var(--mb-button-size); padding: 0 0 0 var(--mb-button-size); margin: 0px; line-height: var(--mb-button-size); vertical-align: middle; appearance: none; outline: none; cursor: pointer; }

.mburger b:nth-of-type(3) { top: calc(50% + var(--mb-bar-spacing)); transition: top 0.2s, transform 0.2s, width 0.2s; }
.mm-wrapper_opened .mburger b:nth-of-type(1) { bottom: calc(50% - var(--mb-bar-height) / 2); transform: rotate(45deg); }

.mm-wrapper_opened .mburger--collapse b:nth-of-type(3) { top: calc(50% - var(--mb-bar-height) / 2); transform: rotate(-45deg); transition-delay: calc(var(--mb-animate-timeout) + 0.3s), calc(var(--mb-animate-timeout) + 0.3s); }
.mm-wrapper_opened .mburger--spin b:nth-of-type(1) { transform: rotate(135deg); transition-delay: calc(var(--mb-animate-timeout) + 0s), calc(var(--mb-animate-timeout) + 0.2s); }
.mm-wrapper_opened .mburger--spin b:nth-of-type(3) { transform: rotate(225deg); transition-delay: calc(var(--mb-animate-timeout) + 0s), calc(var(--mb-animate-timeout) + 0.2s); }
